description: This file defines the IMediaKeysClient interface, which is an abstract base class for handling media key events such as license requests, license renewals, and key status changes within the Rialto media framework. It is intended for implementation by clients or servers that need to respond to DRM-related events in AV content decryption.

classes.name: IMediaKeysClient
classes.description: An interface for receiving notifications related to media key events such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Callback invoked when a license is required, providing the session ID, license request message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Callback invoked when a license renewal is needed, providing the session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the status of keys in a session has changed, providing the session ID and key status vector.
